usdRate.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux du jour (taux de référence)
usdRate.note: Reference rate; bank buying 130.4580 and selling 131.6921 gourdes. Verifier re-read the BRH page on 2 November 2026 and it showed the same 130.7348 reference rate. The CLDR file lists USD for Haiti; the national currency is the gourde (HTG).

inflation_cpi.sourceName: BRH: Évolution de l'indice des prix à la consommation (IHSI data)
inflation_cpi.note: CPI (base 2017-2018=100) 647.6 in September 2026, up 16.4% year on year; inflation has fallen from 31.9% in September 2025.

inflation_projection.note: The BRH publishes no inflation target and the 5-year average is near 29%, but inflation has been falling steadily through 2026, so we plan with a rounded 15%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): Bons BRH, nominal rates by auction
policy_rate.note: The BRH announces no single policy rate; its 91-day BRH bill (Bon BRH) rate, which BRH describes as the reference for banks' treasury operations, has stayed at 11.5% (7-day 6%, 28-day 8%) through the auction of 7 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
savings_account_rate.note: Average gourde savings deposit rate (min 0.03%, max 1.00%) for the week of 28 September 2025, the latest week in the BRH series; older than one year, no 2026 figure published.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The BRH gourde rate series gives one average for all term deposits (3.75%, range 1.5-6.0%, week of 28 September 2025) without a breakdown by maturity; no 3-month figure found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BRH gourde rate series gives one average for all term deposits (3.75%, range 1.5-6.0%, week of 28 September 2025) without a breakdown by maturity; no 1-year figure found.

dps_rate.note: No official series or public product rate for monthly recurring deposits was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate from IMF IFS via the World Bank.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond sold to individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No treasury bill yield for retail investors was found; the 91-day BRH bill (11.5%) is a central bank instrument sold to banks.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries does not cover Haiti and no official tax-authority source on the tax on bank interest could be reached.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found, so no tax rate applies to report.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or coverage amount was found; BRH pages read do not mention one.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate was found; BRH notes interest rate ceilings were abolished in 1989.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock exchange; global equity index in gourde terms
equity_return_low.note: Low case: weak global equities and a stable gourde.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in gourde terms; BRH average gourde term deposit rate 3.75% (Sept 2025)
equity_return_base.note: Haiti has no stock exchange, so we use a global equity index in gourde terms, capped at the average term-deposit rate (3.75%) plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index in gourde terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equities plus some gourde depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price; BRH reference rate
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold and a stable gourde.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price; BRH reference rate
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year plus 3-4% expected gourde depreciation, as the gourde has been stable near 131 per dollar since 2023 but fell sharply before.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank Commodity Markets (Pink Sheet) gold price; BRH reference rate
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and renewed gourde depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case near the bottom of the term-deposit range (1.5%).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case just below the 3.75% average gourde term-deposit rate, since the tax on interest is unknown.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case near the top of the term-deposit range (6%).

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from an insurance supervisor was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates by age from a regulator or other permitted source were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No public premium table for private health insurance by age was found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No health price index was read; we plan with 1 point above the 15% headline assumption, as private care tends to rise faster.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index was read; we plan with the 15% headline assumption.

life_expectancy.note: Men 61.9, women 68.5 (2024). UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net gives 65.5 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projections for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.44 (2025, World Bank), 9.6 (2040) and 17.9 (2065, populationpyramid.net/haiti/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The Office National d'Assurance-Vieillesse (ONA) runs the private-sector pension, but its site and the international social-security databases (SSA, ISSA, ILO) could not be read, so the pension age is not confirmed.

retirement_age_government.note: No readable official source on the civil-service retirement age was found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short deposits near the bottom of the range.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
retirement_return_base.note: Base case below the 3.75% average gourde term-deposit rate, as the tax on interest is unknown.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Banque de la République d'Haïti (BRH): taux d'intérêt sur les opérations en gourdes
retirement_return_high.note: High case with better term-deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: BRH deposit rates; global equity index in gourde terms
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a mix of gourde deposits, gold and global equities.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: BRH deposit rates; global equity index in gourde terms
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half global equities at 7.5% and half deposits at 3.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: BRH deposit rates; global equity index in gourde terms
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with strong equities and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No official source on a non-contributory old-age pension, or its amount, could be found.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No official source on a non-contributory old-age pension could be found.

gratuity_rule.note: No readable source on a statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment under the Haitian Labour Code was found.

public_pension_scheme.note: ONA (Office National d'Assurance-Vieillesse) runs the contributory pension for private-sector workers, but its rules could not be read from an official or permitted secondary source.

savings_account.note: Gourde and US dollar savings accounts are offered; average gourde savings rate about 0.5%.

fdr_3m.note: BRH publishes one average rate for all term deposits, not by maturity.

fdr_1y.note: BRH publishes one average rate for all term deposits, not by maturity.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond is sold to individuals.

tbill_91d.note: The 91-day BRH bill is a central bank instrument sold to banks; no retail treasury bill programme was found.

tbond_5y.note: No government bond for retail investors was found.

tbond_10y.note: No government bond for retail investors was found.

equity_fund.note: Haiti has no stock exchange and no retail equity fund was found.

gold.note: Gold jewellery and coins can be bought from jewellers.

pensionScheme.name: Office National d'Assurance-Vieillesse (ONA)
pensionScheme.note: Contributory old-age insurance for private-sector employees.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Population (MSPP)
